DLC2309:4:t_002:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「A horse face... a storm...! Is that the beast wind everyone's talking about?!」

DLC2309:4:t_003:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Come on! I'll take you on myself!」

DLC2309:4:t_004:0.en:
$$獣人$$
「Damn it! So much for our surprise attack!」

DLC2309:4:t_004:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Raaaagh! I'm not letting you have your way!!」

DLC2309:4:t_004:2.en:
$$獣人$$
「Not bad, you! You've got some real guts!」

DLC2309:4:t_004:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Shut up! Don't think that's all the strength I've got!」

DLC2309:4:t_006:0.en:
$$葵$$
「For an Imperial soldier, the one out in front is pretty fired up.」

DLC2309:4:t_006:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「You're right. He seems like an unusual type.」

DLC2309:4:t_006:2.en:
$$朔哉$$
「So he's a worthy opponent for us, huh?」

DLC2309:4:t_007:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Th-that intensity...! She's like a wild beast!」

DLC2309:4:t_008:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Too bad. He's right there waiting for you.」

DLC2309:4:t_011:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is $$大グレン団$$'s $$グレンラガン$$!」

DLC2309:4:t_011:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「D-did his drill stir up that wind spiraling into the heavens?!」

DLC2309:4:t_011:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「We heard there were people hanging tough out here, so we came a little farther to see for ourselves.」

DLC2309:4:t_011:5.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「So you joined the resistance, too.」

DLC2309:4:t_011:6.en:
$$獣人$$
「Heh... When we went to Japan to find work, we learned that some humans are good people, too.」

DLC2309:4:t_012:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「This is bad! The prisoners started a riot when they saw reinforcements!」

DLC2309:4:t_012:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Tch! They've taken over the transport ship!」

DLC2309:4:t_012:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Resistance fighters. Leave this to us, and protect the transport.」

DLC2309:4:t_012:3.en:
$$獣人$$
「Got it! We're leaving the rest to you!」

DLC2309:4:t_012:4.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「The beast and the wind! You're our hope!」

DLC2309:4:t_013:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Don't falter! We can't just slink off after letting them take back the prisoners!」

DLC2309:4:t_014:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ of $$ハイアデス$$, shall take charge of this battlefield!」

DLC2309:4:t_014:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I admire your fighting spirit.」

DLC2309:4:t_014:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Have your wounds treated, then come serve under me. If you wish, I will make a place for you in $$ハイアデス$$.」

DLC2309:4:t_014:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You'll let me have my way here, won't you?」

DLC2309:4:t_015:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Looks like somebody important just showed up.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ is apparently quite an accomplished general. He's defeated a great many of Earth's units.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「So that's why everyone knows his name.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Actually... That would be because he announces it himself every time he appears on a battlefield.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:5.en:
$$ダリー$$
「He seems very eager to promote himself.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Still, I can feel the presence of a powerful man.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:7.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Yes... He's not an opponent to underestimate.」

DLC2309:4:t_015:8.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$葵$$, $$シモン$$. Fall back and regroup.」

DLC2309:4:t_016:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Hear me, Earthlings! I am $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, right hand to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

DLC2309:4:t_016:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The beast and the wind! Your fame has spread across the western $$オセアニア$$ front, and I have come to fight you!」

DLC2309:4:t_016:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Do not disappoint me! Challenge me with all your strength!」

DLC2309:4:t_016:3.en:
$$葵$$
「I like the sound of that. Just make sure you don't disappoint us, either.」

DLC2309:4:t_016:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$! Your winning streak ends here!」

DLC2309:4:t_016:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$葵$$'s wild power and my drill will punch straight through you and your Empire!!」

DLC2309:4:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$... He was an even tougher enemy than the rumors suggested.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:2.en:
$$葵$$
「He sure was. But from the way he talked, it sounds like he's still hiding a lot of power.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That confidence... I doubt it was a bluff.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then we'll just have to break through that power, too.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「If we drill through everything that stands in our way, we'll reach our true enemy eventually.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:6.en:
$$葵$$
「That's right. We just have to keep running until that day comes.」

DLC2309:4:t_017:7.en:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$. I promise I'll come for you...）

DLC2309:4:t_018:1.en:
$$葵$$
「This match is over, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$!」

DLC2309:4:t_018:5.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Did the shock of losing knock a few screws loose?」

review.context: The beast and wind rescue captured resistance fighters, confront Dabalan Tau and win their first encounter.
decisions: The anonymous two-line drill introduction keeps the reveal anonymous until Simon names Gurren Lagann.
Dabalan recruits the spirited Imperial soldier rather than rebuking his resistance.
